name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for my garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for my garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your garage conversion, look for one with specific experience in garage conversions and ADUs, especially in the Bay Area. Verify their licensing and insurance, and check references from previous clients. Ensure they provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, timeline, and cost breakdown. Clear communication, transparency, and a good understanding of local regulations are key indicators of a reliable partner.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with garage conversion experience in the Bay Area. Verify references, and ensure they provide a detailed, transparent proposal.
